artifact_evidence.limitation: The artifact only contained a qualification JSON reporting missing native evidence; the detailed classification came from the job log.

follow_up_state_as_of_2026_10_25.note: Later workflow/code changes address several root classes, but the old run was not re-executed and every original symptom is not linked individually to a later corrective commit.

limitations: Heuristic triage is not proof every original defect is fixed.
